questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: Failure of integration of the Moro reflex interferes with:
questions.explanation: A retained Moro reflex disturbs protective extension and sitting balance.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: A therapist attempts to estimate the energy expenditure in calories for a cardiac patient performing a selected activity for 15 minutes. Assuming the therapist has a metabolic equivalent value for the activity, what other variables are necessary in order to obtain an estimate of the patient's energy expenditure?

options.C: Patients stroke volume and heart rate
options.D: Patient's residual volume and heart rate

questions.explanation: Estimating calories from METs requires the patient's weight and oxygen consumption.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: B fibres are:
questions.explanation: B fibres are myelinated autonomic preganglionic fibres.

questions.question: If the null hypothesis is rejected, it means that:

options.A: There is a relationship (difference) between the variables
options.B: There is no relationship between the variables

questions.explanation: Rejecting H0 supports the alternative hypothesis.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: Upper limb tension test 2 (ULTT2) preferentially stresses the:

options.C: Median nerve (plus axillary and musculocutaneous nerves)

questions.explanation: ULTT1 and ULTT2a bias the median nerve; ULTT2b the radial nerve; ULTT3 the ulnar nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: In Gaenslen's test, extending the hip of the top leg in side-lying with the lower hip flexed reproduces pain from the:
questions.explanation: Gaenslen's test stresses the sacroiliac joint.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Free nerve endings (type IV receptors) in joint structures are sensitive to:
questions.explanation: Type IV receptors are nociceptors in the capsule, ligaments and fat pads.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: The close-packed position of the interphalangeal joints of the fingers is:
questions.explanation: IP joints lock in full extension and rest in slight flexion.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: A Bennet's fracture is difficult to maintain in reduced position because of the pull of:
questions.explanation: In Bennett fracture the abductor pollicis longus pulls the metacarpal shaft proximally and makes reduction hard to hold.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Clinical Orthopedic Rehabilitation/Brotzman 2nd Ed.
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: Statement is true:

options.A: Rheobase is the duration of impulse that produces a muscle contraction
options.B: In an UMN lesion there is an altered response to electrical stimulation
options.C: A current which rises or falls suddenly is more effective in stimulating an innervated muscle
options.D: Strength--duration curve indicates the site of lesion

questions.explanation: A sudden-rise current stimulates innervated muscle more effectively than a slow-rise one because of accommodation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The amount of US reflected at the bone periosteum interface is:
questions.explanation: About 70% of ultrasound is reflected at the periosteum-bone interface.

questions.question: Fragile X syndrome is caused by a trinucleotide repeat expansion of:
questions.explanation: Leading cause of inherited intellectual disability.

questions.question: Which hormone stimulates glycogen breakdown in the liver?
questions.explanation: Insulin promotes glycogen synthesis.

questions.question: Which device is used in conditions like tight hip adductors or dysplasia of the hip?
